fixturePolicy.credentials: No tenant registrations or real credentials are bundled. Independent generator specimens use synthetic values. Observed responses retain the upstream explicit sanitization or public no-auth capture provenance; embedded test literals are dummy credentials.
fixturePolicy.independence: OpenAPI JSON fixtures are generated from the pinned specifications independently of SDK validators, with explicit reviewed corrections. TypeScript test references are SDK-authored regression evidence and are not claimed as independent API truth. Observed captures are separately labeled.

licenseEvidence.finding: Point-in-time observation: pinned recursive tree has no license-like file; repository license endpoint returned HTTP 404; OpenAPI info has no license declaration. No other repository license is inferred. Offline verification does not refresh this observation.

corrections.policy: Raw upstream bytes are preserved. Apply corrections only through reviewed derivation; generated artifacts are not raw specification coverage. Compatibility descriptions and historical evidence do not establish current live acceptance.

distributionConstraints.requirement: Do not bundle official Gateway YAML or generate distributable artifacts from it until its license is identified. Existing Apache-2.0 TypeScript models and licensed fixture provenance remain the Rust parity baseline.
